steps.value: var modals = document.querySelectorAll('.byte-modal__content, [role=dialog], .modal-content, .bytedance-modal, .byte-drawer'); for (var i = 0; i < modals.length; i++) { var m = modals[i]; if (m.offsetParent !== null) { var btns = m.querySelectorAll('button'); for (var j = 0; j < btns.length; j++) { var t = (btns[j].innerText||'').trim(); if (t === '确认发布' || t === '发布' || t === '确认' || t === '确定') { btns[j].click(); return 'clicked: ' + t; } } } } return 'no_confirm_in_modal';
steps.descript: v3.7.12 在弹窗内查找确认发布按钮并点击（扩大弹窗和按钮匹配范围）

steps.selector: //span[text()="确认发布"] | //button[contains(@class,"byte-btn-primary")]//span[text()="确认发布"] | //button[normalize-space(.)="确认发布"] | //button[contains(@class,"byte-btn-primary") and contains(normalize-space(.),"确认")] | //div[contains(@class,"modal")]//button[contains(text(),"发布")] | //div[contains(@class,"byte-modal")]//button[contains(text(),"发布")] | //button[contains(@class,"byte-btn-primary")]//span[text()="发布"] | //button[normalize-space(.)="发布"]
steps.descript: v3.7.12 确认发布（增加纯文本"发布"按钮兜底匹配）
steps.ai_intent: 找到确认发布按钮并点击

steps.value: for (var i = 0; i < 30; i++) { var btns = document.querySelectorAll('button'); var hasPublish = false; for (var j = 0; j < btns.length; j++) { var t = (btns[j].innerText || '').trim(); if (t === '预览并发布' || t === '预览并定时发布') { hasPublish = true; break; } } if (!hasPublish) { return 'publish_btn_disappeared'; } if (window.location.href.indexOf('profile_v4/graphic/articles') >= 0) { return 'url_changed'; } var toasts = document.querySelectorAll('[class*="toast"], [class*="message"], [class*="notification"]'); for (var k = 0; k < toasts.length; k++) { var tt = (toasts[k].innerText || '').trim(); if (tt.indexOf('发布成功') >= 0 || tt.indexOf('已发布') >= 0) { return 'toast_success: ' + tt.slice(0, 50); } } var now = function() { return new Promise(function(r) { setTimeout(r, 1000); }); }; await now(); } return 'timeout_30s_btn_still_visible';
steps.descript: v3.7.13 发布成功检测（按钮消失/URL跳转/成功提示，三重检测，不依赖单一URL跳转）
v3.7.13 兜底等待 URL 跳转（如已跳转则立即返回）
